title: Cinderella Liberty
actors: James Caan, Marsha Mason, Kirk Calloway
plot: Lonely low-key Navy sailor John Baggs Jr. falls in love with pool-hustling hooker Maggie Paul and becomes a surrogate father figure for her 11-year-old son Doug during an extended liberty due to his service records being lost.
awards: Nominated for 3 Oscars. 1 win & 9 nominations total
